reviewer_notes: Whole pack: repeated unrelated distractors (e.g. tai nạn, tài khoản, kế toán viên) provide very little C1-level semantic discrimination. Best answers independently selected from the meanings follow A-B-C-D repeatedly through Q50. No item presented two equally defensible options, but the distractors rarely test fine distinctions.
Q11 (C): hữu hình is appropriate; rõ ràng alone is too broad for tangible. Có thể cảm nhận/sờ thấy, hoặc cụ thể, có thể nhận thấy rõ better distinguishes its literal and figurative senses.
Q15 (C): thực tế is appropriate for pragmatic. Thực dụng can carry a stronger negative moral connotation in Vietnamese; thiên về giải pháp thực tế is a safer neutral teaching gloss.

Q21 (A): mâu thuẫn, lưỡng lự is imprecise: ambivalent means having mixed/opposing feelings or attitudes toward something, not simply being contradictory or undecided. Prefer có cảm xúc/thái độ trái chiều, vừa muốn vừa không. A is still the closest option.

Q27 (C): là ví dụ điển hình expresses one valid sense of exemplify. The verb also means minh hoạ bằng ví dụ; include that sense or add a sentence to establish whether the subject is an example or gives examples.

Q36 (D): cho là do is valid for attribute something to a cause, but is an incomplete standalone Vietnamese phrase. Quy/cho điều gì là do ai/cái gì or quy cho is clearer; attribution of authorship/credit is another valid use.

Q37 (A) and Q40 (D): both disparity and discrepancy are glossed sự chênh lệch. This is defensible in some contexts but loses a useful distinction: disparity often denotes a difference/gap or inequality, while discrepancy commonly denotes a mismatch or inconsistency between things expected to agree. Use contextualised examples and consider sự không khớp / sai lệch for discrepancy.
Q39 (C): chứng minh bằng bằng chứng is understandable but clumsy repetition. Chứng minh/củng cố bằng chứng cứ or đưa ra bằng chứng xác thực would be more natural.

Q47 (C): duy trì, làm kéo dài is broadly valid for perpetuate, but the verb often concerns causing an undesirable condition, belief, or practice to continue. A contextual example would prevent learners treating it as an unrestricted synonym of maintain.
